scheme_name: The Artist Welfare Fund Of Assam
other_conditions: Applicant must be an artist in the field of art and culture of Assam.
Applicant must be above 20 years of age (if the applicant is the artist).
Applicant must be in financial distress.
Applicant must have made a mark or achievement in the field of art and culture.
Applicant must provide artistic credentials supporting the achievement.
Dependent includes spouse of a deceased artist, minor children, unmarried non‑earning daughters, and parents wholly dependent on the artist.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹50,000 for cancer or kidney transplant, up to ₹20,000 for heart procedures, with additional support decided by the board.
application_link: Standard application form available on the website; submit to the office of Assam State Film (Finance & Development) Corporation Ltd (ASFFDC), Shilpgram Road, near Sankardev Kalakshetra, Panjabari, Guwahati-37.
